verdict: B/O doping introduces wide-gap (5-8 eV) passivating SEI (Li3BO3, Li3B7O12, B2O3, BPO4, Li2O, Li3PO4) absent in undoped LPSCl; thioborates Li3BS3/Li2B2S5 moderate (2.4-3). Only BP(1.08) mildly leaky (minor); Li3P(0.70) pre-existing; BS2(0) won't form. Narrow ESW compensated by passivating interphase.
